tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bstan srung dbang po rnams la mchod gtor 'bul ba'i rim pa nyung gsal go bde bklags chog tu bkod pa bzhugs so// na mo gu ru puṇ+ya rat+na ya/ rgyal kun spyi gzugs rdo rje 'dzin/ /rigs can 'dul ngor sngags 'chang zol/ /kho bo'i skyabs gcig grub pa'i dbang / /bsod nams rin chen zhabs la 'dud/ /sa skya'i rje btsun mchog rnams kyi/ /sa skya'i bstan srung bka' bsgos pa/ /sa skya'i srung ma rnams mchod pa'i/ /sa skya'i man ngag gtor chog bri/ /zhes mchod brjod dam bca' sngon du btang nas/ 'dir bstan srung dbang po rnams la mchod gtor 'bul ba'i rim pa nyung gsal go bde bklags chog tu bkod pa la don gsum ste/ sbyor dngos rjes so/ /dang po ni/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi sku bzhugs pa'i mdun du stegs ras dkar gyis bkab la 'bru sna tshogs bkram pa'i steng zlum gtor gsum bshams pa'i mdun du chu gnyis/ me tog spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas rnams sgreng tshar du bshams/ rang gi mdun du stegs steng rdor dril nang mchod ḍā ma ru 'thor nas rnams shom pa'am/ ma bshams kyang chad skyon med/ mchod gtor rnams nang mchod chu chang gi sbyang ba ni sbyor ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rang de dag la kha phyogs par 'dug la rdor dril bshams tshe rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor tshul dang / med na yid kyi dmigs la/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ swa bhā wā shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bhā wā shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las mchod rdzas rnams a las ban+dha 'bar ba'i snod bdun du mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ nyer spyod rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra a ha ra li hūm̐ phaṭa/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ ud da pha la ya bi ṣ+pu ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā dril bshams tshe dkrol la sngags 'di lan gsum brjod/ gzhan ḍā dril med kyang sngags lan gsum brjod pas byin rlabs/

skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gsal bar dmigs pa'i sku dge 'dun/ gsung dam chos/ thugs bla ma sangs rgyas kun 'dus su bsam/ rang gi mdun rgyab nas g.yas g.yon mtha' skor du gnod byed dgra 'dre pha ma gnyen bshes sems can thams cad 'khod nas yid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dkon mchog gsum skyabs gnas su 'dzin snyam pa'i ngag nas skyabs 'gro 'don par bsams la/ bla ma sangs rgyas chos tshogs la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /'gro ba'i don du yi dam lha/ /yongs su bsgom par sems bskyed do/ /zhes nyer gcig gam/ bcu gcig bdun/ lnga/ gsum la sogs longs skabs dang sbyar ba'i skyabs sems bya/ gong du gsal btab pa'i skyabs yul rdo rje gzhon nu'i thugs ka nas 'od sngon 'phros/ bdag gzhan gyi lus la phogs pas sdig sgrib sbyangs nas sems can rnams sangs rgyas su gyur te so so'i zhing du song bar bsam/ de nas/ sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal dag dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing / /chos kun mnyam nyid rtog par shog /oṃ ma hā shū n+ya tā dzña na badz+ra swa bhā wā āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur me 'od 'bar ba dang bcas pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag mu khyud rdo rjes spras pa'i lte bar pad+ma nyi zla dbang phyug pho mo'i steng du rang hūm̐ las rdo rje gzhon nu sku mdog sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis na rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga/ g.yon gnyis na me dpung kha ṭ+wāṃ/ mtha' ma gnyis kyis phur bu bsgril bas yum la 'khyud pa'i pang na 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma sngon mo g.yas 'khor lo g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang mi mgo skam rlon rin chen rus pa sbrul stag gzig sham thabs gsol ba rol pa'i stabs kyis me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i sku can du gyur pa'i dpral bar oṃ/

mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod la se gol gyi sgras spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs rang la bstims/ slar yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ thal mo sbyar la/ a bhi ṣañtsa tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ri bha wā a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dbang lha rnams rang la thim par bsam/ rang gi snying khar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon gyi mthar/ kī la yas bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus rang la thim/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nan ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dbang dus kyi dam bca' bzhin bzlas tshar ba dang phreng ba has btab spyi bor reg la/ mchog thun dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ mdun gyi gtor ma gsum la dmigs te/ gong bzhin a mṛ ta dang swa bhā wās bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor snod thod par gyur pa'i nang du gtor rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ lag g.yon bstan la oṃ/ g.yas bstan la āḥ gnyis ka bstan la hūm̐/ mthe bong dang gung mo sbyar la gshibs de rgyab srin lag bsnol ba mdzub mo gnyis kyi so sor bzung / mthe chung gnyis gshibs te sgreng ba bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan la/ ha ho hrīḥde 'dra ba lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyai rdo rje lha dgu 'byung po brgyad gsum nyi shu rtsa bzhi thams cad kyang sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rnam pas gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang / lag pa gnyis snying khar bsnol mdzub mo bkug gung mtheb sbyar/ srin lag mthe'u chung gnyis bskum pa rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya se gol gyi sgra dang bcas pas spyan drangs/

mdun du byon pa'i gtor mgron rnams kyi ljags las 'od zer byung ba dbus kyi gtor ma la zug ste gsol bar bsams la/ lag pa'i sor mo phan tshun bsnol ba gyen bslang kha bye ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ ā+oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka he badz+ra kā ya wā kā tsit+ta sa pā ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ bhu dza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ a d+ya nut+pan+na twata oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā'i mthar se gol gyi sgra dang bcas pa las gsum gyis phul/ puṣ+paṃ khu tshur gnyis kha gyen bslang / dhu paṃ/ de nyid kha phub/ dī paṃ/ de nyid las mthe bong gnyis sgreng ba/ gan+dhaṃ/ thal mo kha phye la phyir bstan/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ de nyid kha gyen bstan te nyer spyod lnga phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis nang mchod dngos sam/ med na sems kyis phul bar bsams la 'thor tshul bya zhing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ rdor dril bshams tshe/ g.yas rdo rje snying khar bzung / g.yon dril bu mtshams mtshams su dkrol ba'am/ yang na thal mo sbyar la/ gau rī la sogs brgyad po yis/ /mchod pa rnam pa brgyad kyis mchod/ /sku bzhi ye shes lnga yi dngos/ /kyai yi rdo rje'i tshogs la bstod/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnams la/ /mthun rkyen yid 'dod dngos grub stsol/ /zhes brjod/ yang g.yas kyi gtor ma la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs gong bzhin phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje nag po chen po/ e ka dza ṭi/ 'dod khams dbang phyug gnod sbyin yab yum/ pu tra/ bha tra/ sring mo/ zhing skyong dbang phyug yum bzhi/ dur khrod bdag po yab yum/ dkar bdud lcam dral/ phur srung bcu gnyis/ ru 'dren sde bzhi la sogs pa bka' 'khor dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya se gol gyi sgra dang bcas pas spyan drangs/

pad+ma kā ma la ya satwaṃ/ zhes dang / thal mo kha phye la/ mdun du bkan pa pad+ma'i phyag rgyas gdan phul bas gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar/ gtor mgron rnams mngon sum lta bur bzhugs par bsam/ gong kyai rdor gyi gtor bsngo'i skabs kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ shri ma hā kā lā ya/ ma hā kā li de wī ya/ tsa turmu kha/ sha ma sha na pa ti/ badz+ra kā la yak+ṣa kā li yak+ṣi ṇi/ yak+ṣa pu tra/ ru tra bha ṭa/ ru lu kha si/ badz+ra shan+ti pad+ma sarba mā ra kriṣ+ṇa ka pā la mā la badz+ra kī li kī la ya dha dhi ma ma shrī graṃ sa pā ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ bhu dza kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba sha truṃ bigh+nan mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum se gol gyi sgra dang bcas te phul/ khu tshur gnyis kyi gung mo sgreng ba rtse sbyar la ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ zhes dang / gzhan gong bzhin phyag rgya bcas la/ puṣ+pe nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul la/ rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gdong bzhi pa sogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis ci bsam chos bzhin 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod la me tog gtor/ yang g.yon gyi gtor ma la gong bzhin phyag rgya sngags dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs la/ lag gnyis kyi mdzub mo sbrel gung mo dang mthe bong lto sbyar/ srin mdzub dang mthe'u chung gnyis so sor phral la 'bar ba ltar byas pa dpral ba nas g.yon phyogs su bskor la/ phaiṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ 'dzam bu gling gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod kyi gnas na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro tshad med grangs med bsam gyi mi khyab pa rnams mdun du byon nas gtor ma gsol bar bsams la/ gong mgon po'i gtor 'bul skabs kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra a ra li hoḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇi a d+ya nut+pan+na twata oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum se gol dang bcas pas phul/ ar+ghaṃ sogs rang bzhin gyis mchod la/

gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs thams cad kyi ci bsam chos bzhin du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ yang gtor ma de nyid gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs la/ lag gnyis khu tshur rgyab sbyar ba'i mthe'u chung gnyis sbrel/ mdzub mo gnyis bkug pa hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya dang / bhu mi pa ti sa pā ri wā ra a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas gzhi bdag dbang thob pa rnams mdun du spyan drangs pas/ de rnams kyi gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing / gtor 'bul gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ bhu mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum se gol dang bcas pas phul/ oṃ ā hūm̐ gis nang mchod gtor la/ sa'i lha mo bstan ma/ bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis la sogs pa gnas bdag gzhi bdag yul bdag grong bdag la sogs pa 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis ci bsam chos bzhin 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ zhes brjod/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sogs yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskangs/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyis stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol/ /ces pas nongs pa bzod par gsol/ rten yod na me tog gtor la/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes pas brtan bzhugs bya/ rten med pa'i ye shes pa rnams la/ badz+ra muḥgashegs gsol bya zhing / lha brgyad zhing skyong dbang phyug sogs/ sku rten yod na de nyid kyi sku dang / med na dam ye gnyis ka rang gi snying khar thim par bsam/ rang rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ zhes pas go bgo dge ba 'di yis mtha' yas sems can kun/ /bdud las rnam rgyal bar chad kun btul nas/ /rdo rje gzhon nu mya ngan 'das pa yi/ /'bras bu byang chub nges par thob phyir bsngo/ /zhes pas bsngo ba dang / me tog 'thor zhing dril bu yod na gsil la/

rtsa brgyud bla ma dkon mchog rin chen gsum/ /yi dam lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho yis/ /bden pa'i stobs kyis bdag cag dpon slob kyis/ /ci bsam chos bzhin 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /zhes bkra shis kyis mtha' brten par bya'o/ /de ltar sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi sgo nas/ gtor chog nyung gsal go bde ma tshang ba med par bstan zin to/ /'di yang mdo smad pa'i thig le la dbang bsgyur ba'i stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po sde dge ba'i nang blon bu skyes sam ming gzhan dgra 'dul rdo rje zhes bya ba'i kha 'don du gtor chog bsdus pa zhig dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bdag bskyed 'di sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa'i phur pa'i mngon rtogs bsdus pa dang / gtor chog 'di rnams mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i kyai rdo rje'i mngon rtogs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi rnam gzhag gsal bar bshad pa'i mjug gi gtor chog bzhin las cung zad gong sdebs te bris shing kha bskangs te sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 6 kun dga' blo gros/ bstan srung dbang po rnams la mchod gtor 'bul ba'i rim pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 5
